author: Lintuxer
tagline: Needs slskd for downloads — music discovery and automation
description:
**Downloads need slskd**, a separate app in this same store. Install it
first, then paste its API key into SoulSync under **Settings → Downloads
→ Source Settings** (the slskd URL is already filled in) and press Save.
Without slskd, SoulSync finds and organises music but downloads nothing.

Music discovery and automation platform. Find new music, curate
playlists, sync libraries, and integrate with popular streaming
services, Soulseek (slskd), and media servers. Also manages a video
library (movies, TV, YouTube) with metadata, overlays and a download
pipeline — the video side additionally needs a TMDB and a TVDB API key
before anything on it works.

Writes organised music to /DATA/Media/Music and reads downloads from
/DATA/Downloads, the folders ZimaOS itself suggests, so Plex, Jellyfin
and Navidrome pick the library up without extra mounts.
title: SoulSync
